set.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D input RMB 41,565,949.69 (2.69% of revenue, down 26.92%), of which 39.78% capitalised; 317 R&D staff. The MD&A puts total R&D funding at RMB 11274 ten-thousand, up 22.92%. The report says high-specific-capacitance high-purity tantalum powder samples passed customer certification and are sold in volume; a research project on uniform fine-grain high-purity tantalum aims to push tantalum target volume production.

items.label: Ningxia Orient Tantalum half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)

set.signal: 2026 half-year report: R&D input RMB 23,936,450.47 (down 2.33%). The company says its high-purity tantalum powder for 6N-and-above high-purity tantalum targets broke through two core technologies (deep removal of trace impurities and low-contamination smelting); it mastered processing of two new 1.3GHz niobium RF superconducting cavity models; and niobium-based refractory alloy powder and multi-laser additive manufacturing reached small-batch production.
